content.short: ApeX Protocol is a permissionless decentralized derivatives exchange powered by StarkEx for high performance.
content.description: ApeX Protocol is a leading decentralized derivatives exchange that offers a professional trading experience with high throughput and low fees. By utilizing StarkWare's StarkEx scalability engine, ApeX provides users with deep liquidity and near-instant execution for perpetual contracts across a wide variety of crypto assets. The platform is entirely non-custodial, ensuring that users maintain full control over their funds at all times while enjoying features typically found on centralized exchanges, such as high leverage and advanced order types. With a focus on privacy and security through ZK-proof technology, ApeX Protocol is a cornerstone for decentralized derivatives trading in the multichain Web3 landscape.
